integrity.proof: Matrix multiplication derives the exact resolvent; Jacobi complementary-minor identity and four adjugate tables reconstruct all costs; three positive factorizations prove the hierarchy; elementary complement triangle/path/matching counts prove exhaustive minimizers.
integrity.verification: verify.py checks symbolic identities and exact rational grounded inverse matrices in nine finite graph examples.

scientific_limitations: Three distinct perfectly pinned noise-free leaders, equal independent follower noise, unweighted undirected connected noncomplete strongly regular graphs only.
The count classifies the optimal leader triples but does not solve graph existence from feasible parameter sets.
No extension is proved for noisy/finite-gain leaders or arbitrary nonregular graphs.
A general joint-centrality formula for arbitrary leader sets predates this specialized exact optimization.
title: Exact three-leader coherence and optimal triples on strongly regular networks
